cases.translation: I cried out to God for help.
cases.explain: The preposition о (about/concerning) takes the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: В ___ бедствия моего искал я Владыку.
cases.translation: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) with duration of time takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Всю ___ напролет я простирал руки мои.
cases.translation: All night long I stretched out my hands.
cases.explain: The accusative case with весь indicates duration of time.

cases.translation: I thought of days of old.
cases.explain: The preposition о (about) takes the prepositional case; plural form днях.
The preposition в (in) with location takes the prepositional case.

cases.translation: You kept my eyes from closing.
cases.explain: The verb сомкнуть (to close) takes the accusative direct object; plural глаза.

cases.translation: Did he withhold his love in his anger?
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) with location takes the prepositional case.

cases.translation: Like a flock you led your people.
cases.explain: The verb вел (led) takes the accusative direct object with comparison.

reading.ru: Я о помощи взывал к Богу.
reading.question: What did the speaker cry out to God for?
reading.explain: The text says 'о помощи взывал' — cried out for help.

reading.ru: В день бедствия моего искал я Владыку.
reading.question: When did the speaker seek the Lord?
reading.explain: The verse states 'В день бедствия моего' — In the day of my trouble.

reading.ru: Всю ночь напролет я простирал руки мои.
reading.question: What did the speaker do all night long?
reading.explain: The text says 'простирал руки мои' — stretched out my hands.

reading.ru: Ты не давал мне сомкнуть глаз, я был ошеломлен и не мог говорить.
reading.question: What was the speaker's condition when unable to sleep?
reading.explain: The verse describes 'был ошеломлен и не мог говорить' — was overwhelmed and could not speak.

reading.ru: Твой путь Божий свят, какой Бог так велик, как наш Бог.
reading.question: What makes God unique according to this statement?
reading.explain: The text exalts 'Твой путь Божий свят' and 'какой Бог так велик' — Your way is holy and what God is so great.

reading.ru: Как стадо вел ты свой народ, рукою Моисея и Аарона.
reading.question: Through whom did God lead his people like a flock?
reading.explain: The passage says 'рукою Моисея и Аарона' — by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
